title: 2022 Census of Agriculture, Volume 1, Chapter 2: County Level Data (state text files <st>v1.txt)
publisher: USDA National Agricultural Statistics Service
notes: Table 1 County Summary Highlights (farms; total cropland acres; market value of agricultural products sold, $1,000) and Table 30 Land in Orchards (acres). (D) = withheld to avoid disclosing individual operations (filled as described in the metric methods). Published for 3,079 county units in the 50 states: Alaska is tabulated for 5 agricultural census districts, Connecticut for its 8 former counties; Virginia's independent cities other than Chesapeake, Suffolk and Virginia Beach, Baltimore city (MD), St. Louis city (MO) and Kalawao (HI) have no county column. The Quick Stats bulk file and API were not usable (file gateway / API key).

Boxes: Sri Lanka 4-11.8N 77.8-83.8E; USA CONUS 22-51N 128-64W, Alaska 49-73N 168E-128W (antimeridian crossing), Hawaii 16-25N 163-152W, Northwestern Hawaiian Islands 21-30N 180-161W.
